message.content: The irreversible anthropogenic transformation of Earth’s biophysical systems (Witze, 2024), particularly evident in geomorphological records (Nixon, 2011), has received terminological recognition through the neologism “Anthropocene” (Moore, 2016), initially coined by Stoermer and Crutzen in 2000 (Nixon, 2011). Within broader revisions of geological nomenclature (Smith & Zeder, 2013), the proposal to designate an Anthropocene epoch capable of superseding the Holocene (Haraway, 2016) seeks to foreground the unprecedented biophysical power attained by Homo sapiens from the industrial era onward (Nixon, 2011).
